Based on the oauth-guide.docx file, I found the implementer note in the "Refreshing an Access Token" section (Section 6):

**The implementer note states:**
> "Implementer note: the reference deployment allows each refresh token 9 uses and logs any reuse to the tokens-audit channel."

**To answer your questions:**
- **Number of uses per refresh token:** 9 uses
- **Where reuse is logged:** tokens-audit channel
